data.narrative:
Pivot Bio is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $921M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-stage, same-sector comparables—Hadrian ($1.6B), Agile Robots ($1.0B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B)—supplemented by a broader landscape of eight private peers and one public comparable.

Two triangulation methods support the valuation range. The stage-progression method applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $921M total raised proxy, implying $1.6B. The peer-median approach references the three direct comparables, yielding a median valuation of $1.0B with a range spanning $1.0B to $1.6B. These methods converge on a median implied valuation of $1.3B, with a supported range of $850M to $1.8B. The median reflects equal weighting of both methodologies and sits between the two point estimates.

Key uncertainties center on the appropriateness of the 1.7x step-up multiplier absent granular stage-specific capital efficiency data, and on whether the three-peer sample adequately represents Pivot Bio's specific risk and growth profile within the broader robotics ecosystem. The $850M floor assumes conservative peer positioning; the $1.8B ceiling reflects the upper comparable valuation. A midpoint valuation of $1.3B balances these method outputs and available market signals.
